jobs.title: Lead Business Control Officer - Global Credit Card
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

As a Lead Business Control Officer (BCO) for the Global Credit Card business, you will play a critical role in strengthening Nu’s first line of defense and enabling sustainable growth of our credit card portfolio globally. You will partner closely with senior leaders across Global Credit Card, Product, Operations, and Risk to proactively identify, assess, and manage non-financial risks, ensuring that business objectives are achieved with a strong and efficient control environment.

You will be a hands-on leader, setting the bar for risk excellence while enabling innovation. You will help establish and continuously evolve the BCO model for Global Credit Card, embedding risk ownership in the first line, challenging how we work today, and helping us build best-in-class risk management practices.

You’ll be responsible for

  • Acting as the primary first-line risk partner for the Global Credit Card business, balancing risk management with business objectives and customer impact.

  • Driving a thorough understanding of end-to-end processes, risks, and controls across the Global Credit Card lifecycle, from product design and onboarding to servicing, collections, and support.

  • Designing, assessing, and continuously improving internal controls to ensure risks are identified, mitigated, and monitored effectively.

  • Leading and coordinating first-line risk management activities, including risk and control self-assessments (RCSA), loss and risk event management, issue remediation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Ensuring strong governance, risk, and compliance practices in alignment with internal policies, global frameworks, and applicable external regulations.

  • Supporting product and feature development by bringing a proactive risk lens to strategic decisions, business cases, and go-to-market plans.

  • Defining, tracking, and reporting meaningful risk and control metrics (KPIs/KRIs) that enable effective monitoring of the control environment and timely decision-making.

  • Building and running pragmatic, non-bureaucratic governance forums that bring together key stakeholders to discuss risks, controls, incidents, and remediation plans.

  • Preparing and presenting clear, concise risk reports and updates to senior leadership and relevant governance bodies.

  • Partnering with second and third lines of defense to ensure alignment, transparency, and effective challenge, while maintaining strong ownership of risks in the first line.

  • Contributing to the ongoing evolution of the BCO framework at Nu, sharing best practices, proposing improvements, and helping shape how we operate as a global first-line risk team.


We are looking for a person who has

  • Proven experience working with credit card products and businesses, preferably in a global or multi-market environment.

  • Solid experience in non-financial risk management, operational risk, or related risk disciplines within financial services or fintech.

  • Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, governance, and regulatory expectations for consumer credit products.

  • Experience designing, assessing, and improving processes and internal controls, including documentation and process mapping.

  • Proven ability to influence and build strong relationships with stakeholders at different levels of the organization, including senior leaders.

  • A hands-on, ownership-driven mindset, with the ability to dive deep into details while keeping a strategic view of risks and priorities.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex issues into clear actions and decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to convey risk topics in a clear, concise, and structured way.

  • Independence, proactivity, and a strong desire to challenge the status quo and improve how we work.

Nice to have

  • Experience in first-line risk roles directly embedded in business or product teams.

  • Prior exposure to SOX or similar internal control over financial reporting frameworks.

  • Experience working with teams across different countries and cultures.

  • Knowledge of data, analytics, or tooling that can help automate and enhance risk and control monitoring.


Location for this opportunity

Virgínia (DC Metro)



Our Benefits (United States)

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu.

  • Medical Insurance.

  • Dental and Vision Insurance.

  • Life Insurance and AD&D.

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves.

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses.

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program.

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program.

  • 401K.

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account.

  • Work-from-home Allowance.

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.


Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times | week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/.

We offer relocation package for those who are available to be relocated to the DC region.

Learn more about how we build at Nu

Explore how we build products, technology, and experiences at Nu:

  • https://building.nubank.com.br

  • https://youtube.com/@building.nubank

  • https://open.spotify.com/show/4hAJnAkYKXl42hLXa4LmVQ

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Insider Threat Defense
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

Nubank is creating its first dedicated Insider Threat Defense team, and you will be the leader who builds it from scratch. Sitting within Information Security, this first-line-of-defense team detects and responds to risks coming from inside the company, such as privileged access misuse, sensitive data exfiltration, credential sale and collusion, sabotage, and remote worker and hiring fraud.

Protecting the trust of more than 127 million customers starts with protecting our own access and data. This is a structural, high-visibility role with M-team sponsorship, and you will own the strategy, the roadmap, and the results: detection coverage, speed of detection, and quality of response.

You will hire and lead the squad, define the scenarios that matter most, and work closely with Conduct Risk (2LOD), Legal, People, Risk, and Privacy. The team detects and qualifies; those areas decide on consequences, keeping a clear separation of roles and independent challenge.


You'll be responsible for

  • Building the team: hire, lead, and develop a specialized squad of detection experts, analysts, and engineers, starting with a small team and growing across Brazil and our international locations, in a high-performance, inclusive, and AI-first culture.

  • Defining strategy and roadmap: set the Insider Threat Defense strategy, scenario taxonomy, and priorities, focusing on the highest residual-risk scenarios (e.g., product abuse, data leakage, privileged access misuse, queue manipulation, code of conduct breaches).

  • Creating the foundations: define policies, scope, documentation, and operating model for a capability that doesn't exist yet at Nubank.

  • Owning governance and key interfaces: work with People, Legal, Risk, Privacy, and Conduct Risk on sensitive cases, preserving line separation and formal model-risk governance.

  • Operating through shared services: ensure effective handoffs and clear SLAs with GSOC (24/7 triage), CSIRT (response and containment), and Threat Detection.

  • Driving automation and AI: use AI and automation to correlate identity, access, and data movement signals and reduce manual analyst effort, without losing detection quality.

  • Reporting to leadership: give executives, regulators, and Internal Audit enterprise-wide visibility of insider risk, including a monthly governance forum and an annual review.


We are looking for a person who has

  • Led security detection, response, or investigation teams, ideally standing up a new capability in a high-scale environment.

  • Hands-on knowledge of insider threat or internal fraud scenarios in technology or financial companies, including UEBA, privileged access misuse, and data exfiltration patterns.

  • Solid technical grounding in SIEM, SOAR, detection engineering, and incident response, enough to guide technical decisions and challenge the team.

  • Worked with People, Legal, Privacy, and Risk on sensitive topics, with strong judgment and discretion.

  • Hired, coached, and grown senior individual contributors, and managed performance.

  • Translated complex technical risks into clear, actionable messages for executives and regulators.

  • Proficiency in English (understanding and speaking) for global collaboration.


Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services or other regulated environments, including regulatory expectations on non-financial risk and three-lines-of-defense models.

  • Experience in insider threat programs, internal fraud, or hybrid cyber/physical investigations.

  • Experience in cloud environments (AWS/GCP) and modern data platforms for security analytics.

  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, or CERT Insider Threat guidance.

  • Experience leading teams across multiple locations and time zones.


Location for this opportunity (City, Country)

  • São Paulo, Brazil

  • Campinas, Brazil

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

  • Belo Horizonte, Brazil


Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable


Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Explore how we build technology at Nubank

🎥 youtube.com/@building.nubank

🎧 Listen to our stories on Spotify

jobs.title: Head of Risk US
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the Team

The Global Risk function at Nu is structured around two dimensions: country risk officers (horizontal) and global functional heads by risk discipline (vertical). This matrix creates a "risk surface" that allows the organization to scale efficiently without duplicating senior expertise across geographies.

The Head of Risk US will lead the US risk surface, owning all risk disciplines locally while maintaining close coordination with global functional heads: Global Credit Risk, the Global Market and Liquidity Head, and other risk domain leads.

The US risk team is in its early stages, with existing members covering Compliance, Financial Crime/AML, Regulatory, and is expected to grow in line with the business. This is a build-from-scratch opportunity for a senior executive who thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments.

About the Role

The Head of Risk US is a senior executive responsible for the effective and independent oversight of all risk disciplines within Nu's US operation.

The role requires a leader who understands the US regulatory landscape deeply, can engage independently with regulators and senior governance bodies, and is capable of building a high-performing risk function in a fast-moving fintech environment.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact position that will interact frequently with the US Board/Risk Committee, senior regulators, and Nu's executive leadership team.

Key Responsibilities and Expectations

Risk Framework & Governance

  • Build and lead a comprehensive risk management framework for the US operation, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, financial crime, and compliance risk.

  • Develop a risk appetite framework and limit structure aligned with the US Board's stated risk tolerance, ensuring all business lines operate within defined parameters.

  • Establish robust risk metrics, reporting dashboards, and early warning indicators to monitor exposures and escalate material issues in a timely manner.

  • Serve as Secretary to the US Board Risk Management Committee; prepare and circulate agendas and minutes.

  • Participate as a permanent member of key senior management committees including the Risk Committee, ALCO, Compliance Committee, and New Product Approval Committee.

Regulatory Engagement

  • Serve as the primary independent risk voice in all interactions with US regulators, engaging with confidence and autonomy.

  • Ensure Nu's control environment consistently meets and anticipates regulatory expectations in a rapidly evolving US regulatory landscape.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with regulators, demonstrating transparency, preparedness, and a mature risk culture.

Risk Surface Management

  • Oversee the day-to-day management of the US risk surface, coordinating with global functional heads on credit, market/liquidity, operational, and financial crime risk.

  • Apply Nu's "target friction" philosophy: prioritize controls based on materiality, avoiding uniform friction in favor of risk-proportionate management that enables business growth.

  • Monitor operational loss events, cyber incidents, and key risk indicators, ensuring mitigation strategies are in place and effective.

Team & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Lead and develop the US risk team, fostering a culture of high standards, intellectual rigor, and ownership.

  • Build a strong working relationship with engineering and technology teams to ensure risk infrastructure is prioritized and developed appropriately.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with the US Country Manager, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to embed risk awareness across the organization.

  • Act as a business partner to the US leadership team — risk as an enabler, not a blocker.

Qualifications

Professional Experience & Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MSc Finance, JD) or professional certification (CFA, FRM) preferred.

  • 15+ years of experience in risk management within financial services, with a significant portion of that in the US market.

  • Deep expertise in the US regulatory environment (OCC, Fed, FDIC); experience engaging directly with regulators at a senior level is essential.

  • Background in financial institutions, fintechs, or challenger banks strongly preferred. Candidates with exclusive experience at large traditional banks (without demonstrated adaptability) may not be the right fit for this stage of growth.

  • Experience building or significantly transforming a risk function from an early/mid-stage into a mature framework.

  • Solid understanding of all risk disciplines: credit, market, liquidity, operational, financial crime, and compliance — with particular depth in the control environment (AML/BSA, operational risk, cyber).

  • Credit risk expertise is valued but not the primary focus; Nu's global credit function provides strong support in this area.

Competencies & Attributes

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a proven ability to build structure from scratch in fast-moving environments — "generating balance based on chaos."

  • Hands-on leader who is present on the ground and willing to be deeply involved in operational realities, not just strategic oversight.

  • Independent thought leader capable of engaging directly with boards and regulators without relying on hierarchical support for every interaction.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, particularly with engineering/technology teams — able to translate risk requirements into development priorities and negotiate trade-offs effectively.

  • Risk philosophy aligned with Nu's approach: sees friction as a tool to be applied proportionally to materiality, not a default stance. Views risk as a business partner.

  • Highly adaptive: able to respond quickly to changes in the regulatory landscape and reprioritize accordingly.

  • Intellectually curious, data-driven, and committed to continuous learning.

Work Setup

Location

Miami, US
Washington, US

Work model

Expected: Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

 

Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

 - Build a strong working relationship with engineering and technology teams to ensure risk infrastructure is prioritized and developed appropriately.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with the US Country Manager, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to embed risk awareness across the organization.

 - Act as a business partner to the US leadership team — risk as an enabler, not a blocker.


QUALIFICATIONS

Professional Experience & Education

 - Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MSc Finance, JD) or professional certification (CFA, FRM) preferred.

 - 15+ years of experience in risk management within financial services, with a significant portion of that in the US market.

 - Deep expertise in the US regulatory environment (OCC, Fed, FDIC); experience engaging directly with regulators at a senior level is essential.

 - Background in financial institutions, fintechs, or challenger banks strongly preferred. Candidates with exclusive experience at large traditional banks (without demonstrated adaptability) may not be the right fit for this stage of growth.

 - Experience building or significantly transforming a risk function from an early/mid-stage into a mature framework.

 - Solid understanding of all risk disciplines: credit, market, liquidity, operational, financial crime, and compliance — with particular depth in the control environment (AML/BSA, operational risk, cyber).

 - Credit risk expertise is valued but not the primary focus; Nu's global credit function provides strong support in this area.

Competencies & Attributes

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a proven ability to build structure from scratch in fast-moving environments — "generating balance based on chaos."

 - Hands-on leader who is present on the ground and willing to be deeply involved in operational realities, not just strategic oversight.

 - Independent thought leader capable of engaging directly with boards and regulators without relying on hierarchical support for every interaction.

 - Strong stakeholder management skills, particularly with engineering/technology teams — able to translate risk requirements into development priorities and negotiate trade-offs effectively.

 - Risk philosophy aligned with Nu's approach: sees friction as a tool to be applied proportionally to materiality, not a default stance. Views risk as a business partner.

 - Highly adaptive: able to respond quickly to changes in the regulatory landscape and reprioritize accordingly.

 - Intellectually curious, data-driven, and committed to continuous learning.


WORK SETUP

Location

Miami, US
Washington, US

Work model

Expected: Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

 


OUR BENEFITS

 - Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

 - Medical Insurance

 - Dental and Vision Insurance

 - Life Insurance and AD&D

 - Extended maternity and paternity leaves

 - Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

jobs.title: Tech Lead Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the role

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team. The software engineer is focused on software development with Clojure as the main programming language (We will teach you Clojure). Main responsibilities:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture

  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka

  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS

  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB

  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus

  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

You will be responsible for

  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture

  • Set technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies

  • Drive pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies

  • Mentor engineers across teams, establishing and maintaining a high technical bar organization-wide

  • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code. Able to pair and participate in code reviews to contribute to the growth of others in and around the team

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new experiences

  • Ensure comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and error handling across team services

  • Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary

  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies

  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users

  • Strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with ability to work across multiple languages

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams without direct authority

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations

  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD

  • Good communication skills to prevent risks and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Advanced English skills

Our Benefits

  • Health Insurance

  • Life Insurance

  • Pension Plan

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Vacations

Total compensation includes base salary, RSUs and benefits. Base salary range: $168,000 - $210,000

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the role

As a team who drives product development from ideation to full rollout, the Design team ensures that our product experiences are valuable to our users. Designers at Nubank must deal with complex problems and transform them into intuitive, accessible and easy-to-use experiences for millions of people.
At each stage, a Designer must anticipate our customers and business needs, advocate for our users and ensure that the final design surprises and delights them. Achieving this goal requires collaboration with teams of Designers, Researchers, Business Analysts, Software Engineers, Product Managers and many other, working in projects that go from user interviews and prototypes to internal tools and brand assets.
Given this, designers must be flexible and eager to learn - it's unlikely that you'll arrive an expert in all tools and project phases, but you should be humble and have a strong desire and capacity to learn. It's critical that you are able to collaborate with people with varying backgrounds, give good feedback and apply critical feedback received. The combination of these skills along with your talent and technical competence as a designer can make you a great fit for the Nubank Design team.

Once here, you will:

  • Be a technical reference for the team, seeking to adapt and replicate the best practices in the market, increasing the team’s bar;

  • Build links with other business areas at all levels of the organization, influencing business decisions advocating for user-centered design;

  • Inspire fellow product designers, by creating a high bar of quality design work;

  • Establish and promote a healthy team culture that works hand in hand with cross-functional partners and design teams in other Nubank offices;

  • Push the boundaries of your team’s UX/UI/visual execution and help Nubank challenge the status quo.

Requirements

  • Solid expertise in Product Design (UI, UX, and Research);

  • Experience in digital products;

  • Ability to work well in a highly collaborative and cross-functional team;

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment;

  • Ability to influence prioritization in an agile environment. Adapt to shifting priorities and evolving stakeholder’s needs with openness and agility.

 

Our benefits

  • Top Tier Medical Insurance

  • Top Tier Dental and Vision Insurance

  • 20 days time off and 14 company holidays. 

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid (3 days in-office per week): Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/ 

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here
